category_edits.rationale: Apply 0.02 label smoothing over real item classes across all four datasets to mildly reduce overconfidence, retaining equal masked-position weighting and temperature 1. Architecture, sampling, scoring, checkpoints and predictor remain compatible.

change_summary: Add 0.02 label smoothing to the existing full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy for each category’s single BERT4Rec model.
